t: Victory Dances and Rabbit Holes: A Developer's Dual-Brain Blueprint
s: This article presents a developer's dual-brain approach to complex work: a left-brain checklist for execution and a right-brain compass of metaphors for strategic navigation. It emphasizes defining success upfront, avoiding pitfalls, and using tools like Jupyter Notebooks as an escape hatch from complexity.
sub: Developer's dual-brain methodology (left-brain execution, right-brain strategy)
Falsifiability as a litmus test for work and scientific theories
Three guiding metaphors for navigating projects: 'What's most broken?', 'Biggest bang for buck?', 'Plates to spin?'
Jupyter Notebooks as a pragmatic escape hatch from complex development rabbit holes
Four core questions for defining 'winning' and maximizing productive outcomes
